answer: Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the sparrow queue naming the falcon that holds the sponsor's bond. A new identity serves a probation of 10 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Thus, every alias costs 10 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the comet record exposes exactly who is still on probation. That is 26 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
